create_free_transformer: create a FreeTransformer model with specified token count, dimension, and latent bits
build_binary_mapper: build a BinaryMapper that converts logits to discrete one-hot latent codes with KL regularization
encode_to_latents: encode decoder head embeddings into binary latent codes via cross-attention encoder
generate_text: generate text autoregressively from the FreeTransformer with optional conditioning latents and KV caching
train_free_transformer: train the FreeTransformer by computing autoregressive loss plus KL auxiliary loss on input sequences
